answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the protocol enforces cryptographic stake burning where registering an identity requires burning deposits that scale superlinearly as O(N^2). Under this quadratic friction, an attacker attempting to simulate an ivory tower of agents faces exponential capital exhaustion. Just as deep shale resists hydraulic fracturing or a willow absorbs kinetic stress, the burning mechanism bends and breaks adversarial economics while legitimate single agents incur negligible marginal cost.
